$meta.purpose: Per-family address book across the MLIR layers + the CONTAINMENT machine-check source of truth. Each family declares its OWNED source territory (source_ranges: lib/{Dialect,Conversion,Plugin,Target}/<Fam>/ + include/ mirrors -- the enforced containment scope), plus an informational inventory of its test/schema-table/docs footprint. The [F-3] gate asserts: (default) every family-territory source file is claimed by exactly one manifest (no orphan, no cross-family pollution) and no family range escapes into the family-AGNOSTIC core scope; (CI) a family-integration PR's diff touches ONLY that one family's territory plus the shared allowances (TABLE ROWS + DOCS + [P-2] tests). A cross-family or core-source file touched by a family PR is a containment violation (RED).
$meta.gate_semantics: RED iff (a) DEFAULT: a lib/include family-territory code file (under lib/{Dialect,Conversion,Plugin,Target}/<X>/ or its include mirror, X not a declared core_subdir) is claimed by zero manifests (orphan) or by >=2 manifests (cross-family pollution), OR a family source_range matches an authoritative core-scope file (range widened into core), OR a family-shaped directory exists with no manifest entry, OR the shrink-only ratchet breaks (baseline_range_count != total declared source_ranges); (b) CI: a base..head diff touches >=2 distinct families' source territory (cross-family), OR touches a core-source code file while it is a family-integration PR (core edit). GREEN == every family stays contained to its own territory + shared allowances.

containment_scope.core_authority: The authoritative family-AGNOSTIC core scope is schema/family-regex.v1.json core_scope (the I3 zero-branch core control-flow file set). The anti-widen check asserts NO family source_range matches any file in that set -- a family may never claim family-agnostic core source. Reusing that manifest keeps a single authoritative core definition (no duplication of canon).

core_subdirs.note: Non-family subdirectories that legitimately live under the four family roots (lib/{Dialect,Conversion,Plugin,Target}/ and include mirrors). A subdir here is CORE, not a missing-manifest family directory -- the orphan check skips them. Any OTHER subdir under a family root that is not a declared family => unknown-family-dir RED (a new family added without a manifest).

$meta.same_address_discipline: Maintained SAME-ADDRESS as the [F-EMIT] emit-bypass whitelist (schema/emit-bypass-whitelist.v1.json) and the [F-1] family-regex manifest (schema/family-regex.v1.json): one schema/ directory, one shrink-only ratchet idiom, one checker-in-tools/lint + job-in-falsifier-gate.yml idiom. SCOPE NOTE: the family list here is a SUPERSET of family-regex.v1.json (which lists only dispatch-KEY families + the illustrative forbidden Sophgo/AME) and family-dirs.v1.json (which lists only families with a C2 cost-ledger row, IME/Scalar) -- containment covers EVERY directory-owning family, including the scaffold/example families (Template / TensorExtLite / Toy) that own lib/{Dialect,Plugin,Target}/<Fam>/ dirs and must therefore also be contained. Any RVV/IME/Scalar/Offload entry MUST stay consistent with the corresponding family-regex.v1.json entry.
$meta.ratchet_note: baseline_range_count MUST EQUAL the total number of declared source_ranges patterns across all families (the gate fails closed on drift), so a range can never be added OR removed SILENTLY -- any change forces a visible baseline_range_count bump in the same diff (the tamper-evident tripwire, identical mechanism to the [F-EMIT] baseline_count==len(entries) ratchet). The containment direction: an EXISTING family's declared territory only NARROWS ('只减不增' -- a widened range that swallows a core/other-family file is independently caught by the anti-widen + no-overlap checks); a NEW family adds its block WITH a baseline bump. This blocks '偷偷扩范围骗绿' (silently widening a family's declared territory to make an improper core edit fall inside it and pass containment).
